From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@hallowayhealth.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@hallowayhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment commissioning runbook & kickoff — Halloway Health

Hi team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your private deployment. Attached is the initial commissioning checklist (env-commissioning-checklist.xlsx) — this is our working runbook for the VPC/on-prem handoff. Goal is to complete the items in sections A–D, validate networking and KMS ownership, and schedule the activation window.

High-level asks:
- Halloway: confirm preferred maintenance window for the activation (see suggested slots below).
- Halloway: confirm whether you want a customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed (we can support both; see options).
- Redwood infra: review port and egress requirements and flag any blockers for customer firewall or proxy configuration.

Suggested maintenance windows (UTC):
- Oct 8 21:00–00:00 (preferred)
- Oct 9 02:00–05:00

Marcus / Dev / Laura — please review the checklist, attach any network matrices or port lists you want me to send to the customer, and call out any items that require a change freeze or pre-approval.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Principal GTM Program Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
(415) 555-0189

Attachments: env-commissioning-checklist.xlsx
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@hallowayhealth.com>

Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@hallowayhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment commissioning runbook & kickoff — Halloway Health

Naomi — thanks, this looks good. A couple of questions from our side before we lock in the window: 

1) Egress / IP allowlist — do you provide static egress IPs for the hosted control-plane callbacks, or should we plan to open outbound to a Redwood CIDR? We prefer to lock down to IPs if possible.
2) Ports — our infra team needs a short matrix (TCP/UDP + direction + purpose) we can hand to the firewall admin.
3) KMS — we prefer customer-managed KMS in our AWS account (us-west-2). Please confirm the key policy requirements and whether Redwood needs a cross-account IAM role to use the key.

We can do Oct 8 21:00–00:00 UTC as your preferred window. Attaching a small extract from our SOC2 questionnaire with relevant questions (soc2-extract.pdf).

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@hallowayhealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment commissioning runbook & kickoff — Halloway Health

Samantha — thanks for the quick reply. Short answers up front and a summarized ports list below. I'll attach the full matrix (network-ports-summary.pdf).

1) Egress IPs: we can provide a short list of static egress IPs for control-plane callbacks when the account is provisioned. For peak resiliency we recommend allowing a Redwood CIDR as fallback.

2) Ports (summary):
- TCP 443 out -> Redwood control-plane endpoints (TLS) — outbound only
- TCP 5222/5223 out -> real-time telemetry (if you opt-in)
- TCP 22 in -> (optional) SSH jumpbox for troubleshooting (must be locked to our support IPs and MFA enforced)
- UDP 123 out -> NTP to ntp.redwood.com (or we can use your internal NTP)
- TCP 2049 in/out -> NFS (if using shared file mounts)

Please see attached network-ports-summary.pdf for full port/direction/purpose and suggested firewall rules.

3) KMS: customer-managed KMS in us-west-2 is supported. We require a cross-account IAM role with kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey permissions. Key policy should explicitly allow the Redwood role ARN; I'll include a policy snippet in kms-key-options.md (attached). If you prefer Redwood-managed keys, we can provision a key in our KMS and provide documented access controls.

Maintenance window: Oct 8 21:00–00:00 UTC works. We recommend a 45-minute validation period after activation with on-call infra present.

Action items assigned:
- Marcus: finalize port matrix + KMS policy snippet (attached).
- Dev: prepare a quick rollout checklist for model and runtime pinning (will send by EOD).
- Naomi: send SOW/DocuSign link and updated commissioning runbook to Halloway.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: network-ports-summary.pdf, kms-key-options.md
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-05T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment commissioning runbook & kickoff — Halloway Health

Samantha / Mike — thanks for the confirmations and for the SOC2 extract. We have:
- Confirmed maintenance window: Oct 8 21:00–00:00 UTC (45 min validation afterwards).
- KMS approach: customer-managed in us-west-2 (Marcus to provide policy snippet).
- Redwood will supply static egress IPs for allowlist (Marcus noted fallback CIDR).

I uploaded the commissioning runbook (version 1) to the shared Drive and sent the SOW to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/pm/signer?env=SOW-4821

Please review the preflight tab in the checklist — items highlighted in yellow are required before we start the activation.

Next steps:
- Halloway infra to confirm firewall admin contact and provide test IP for SSH access if you want the optional jumpbox enabled.
- Halloway security to confirm KMS key ARN and add Redwood role to the key policy once Marcus shares the snippet.

I'll follow up the day before the window with the final run-of-show and on-call cell numbers.

Thanks,
Naomi
